# Timing belt replacement and coolant upgrade

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install timing belt kit, replace upper lower and ninety degree hoses, then consider adding a fourth hose. [t1503]

## Parts

- 90° radiator hose [t1503]
- Lower radiator hose [t1503]
- Timing belt kit [t1503]
- Upper radiator hose [t1503]

## Tips & gotchas

- Consider swapping in a supercharger (S/C) style radiator to address past overheating issues. [t1503]
- [Partial] [Unverified value] Use more than 2 gallons of coolant if upgrading the system. [t1503]
